Backend: 34/35 pytest pass covering invites (create/list/preview/revoke), family info (auto short_code NEST-XXXX, name update, validation), public preview-code, family/join safety (blocks if data exists; solo can join), shopping templates CRUD+apply with frequent_items increment, and auth/session accepting invite_token body field. Frontend: WeekendCard runtime crash fixed (missing import); all iteration 2 UI flows confirmed (family card shows NEST-F854 code + editable name, Invite Partner modal with Invite link/Family code tabs, Join modal, Shopping Templates modal, Event modal with Repeat+Reminder selects). 1 CRITICAL backend bug: EventCreate Pydantic model is missing recurring/recur_until/reminder_minutes fields - they are silently dropped by server and never persisted, so recurring events will not expand and reminders will not fire end-to-end.

critical.issue: EventCreate Pydantic model (server.py lines 52-60) does not declare recurring, recur_until, reminder_minutes fields. Pydantic v2 silently drops them on input, and they never reach MongoDB. Verified via test: stored event has no recurring/recur_until/reminder_minutes keys. Frontend UI/lib/events.js rely on these fields -> recurring events & reminders are broken end-to-end despite UI appearing to work.

minor.issue: @app.on_event('shutdown') deprecated in FastAPI - use lifespan context manager (carried over from iteration 1).
Dead code: for p in parents: if isinstance(...): pass (carried over).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTER: Missing import of dateKey/expandEvents from ../lib/events caused ReferenceError: dateKey is not defined - entire dashboard rendered blank red error overlay. Added import; dashboard now renders.

integration_issues.issue: Even though event-recurring-select / event-reminder-select data-testids exist and UI submits the values, backend drops the fields (see backend critical bug). End-to-end: user selects Weekly repeat -> event saves but does NOT recur in calendar grid, reminder poller has no reminder_minutes to check.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py EventCreate model missing recurring/recur_until/reminder_minutes fields - BLOCKS the headline iteration-2 feature.
WeekendCard.jsx had broken imports that dateKey call was trying to use globally - crashed entire dashboard. Points to a pre-commit lint/test gap; ESLint no-undef would have caught this.

server.py /api/family/join safety check correctly uses count_documents across children/events/shopping_items/notes and other_parents; good separation. But does NOT check shopping_templates or invites - an edge case where a solo user created invites/templates then tries to join another family would still succeed and orphan those docs under the old family_id. Consider also cleaning/migrating or blocking.
server.py /api/family/info does not require role check - any authenticated family member can rename the family. Acceptable for MVP; consider restricting to the creator later.
server.py create_invite does not dedupe: user can create unlimited invites. Add a soft cap (e.g. 5 live invites per family) to prevent token table bloat.
server.py preview_family_code uses code.upper() but create uses generate_family_code returning upper - good. Add unique index on families.short_code to prevent collisions under races.

Frontend lib/events.js not reviewed in depth; once backend persists the recurring fields, revalidate expandEvents produces the correct occurrences for daily/weekly/monthly boundaries (DST, month-end).

rca_of_the_issue: EventCreate Pydantic model was not updated when recurring/reminder features were added. Pydantic v2 defaults to model_config extra='ignore', so the frontend's extra fields were silently discarded. Server stored event has only title/description/date/time/category/assigned_to/color. Reproduce: POST /api/events with {title, date, recurring:'weekly', recur_until:'2026-05-10', reminder_minutes:60} then GET /api/events - stored doc lacks those 3 keys. Fix: add Optional fields to EventCreate.
